title: It's not as pictured the space is very very thin small and not practical.
text: It's not as pictured the space is very very thin small and not practical.. I did not like this product, it's extremely thin you cannot hold anything on it maybe for office supplies but not as a beauty holder, the space is extremely thin I thought I'd be able to at least fit some eyeshadows or lipsticks other similar thin things on it but I cannot, not even small eyeshadows fit, I dunno, save your money and buy something more practical that actually has space.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Plastic 4 Tier Cosmetic Palette Organizer with 4 Compartments for Bathroom Vanity, Countertop or Cabinet to Hold Makeup, Lipstick, Eyeliner, Beauty Accessories - Clear/Rose Gold

STORAGE MADE SIMPLE: Perfect for all of your cosmetic and makeup needs; A compact storage solution that conveniently stores eye shadows, contour palettes, lip kits, blush, compacts, essential oils, lip gloss, powders, eyebrow kits, bronzers, brow pencils, tweezers, cuticle scissors, nail trimmers and small travel sized perfume bottles and roller ball sticks
